installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Red Discord Bot Installation Script

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git python3 python3-pip python3-venv build-essential openjdk-17-jre-headless wget

cd /mnt/server

# Create virtual environment if it doesn't exist
# Note: Pterodactyl usually runs the install script as root in a separate container
# We want to install dependencies that will be available to the user

# However, for Red, it's best to install in the user space or global if it's a dedicated container
# Since the Dockerfile we made installs dependencies globally or in the user path, we can just pip install here

if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
    pip3 install -U -r requirements.txt
else
    pip3 install -U Red-DiscordBot
fi

# Ensure entrypoint exists if not provided by image (though our image has it)
if [ ! -f "entrypoint.sh" ]; then
    wget -O entrypoint.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cog-Creators/Red-DiscordBot/V3/develop/entrypoint.sh || echo "Could not download entrypoint.sh, assuming it is in the image"
fi
